title: Larry K. Wilson Regional Student Activities Award
description: The purpose of this award is to recognize, annually, in each Region of the IEEE, the Student member most responsible for an extraordinary accomplishment associated with Student Activities.

title: The Darrel Chong Student Activity Award
description: The purpose of this recognition system serves to change the mindset of our student groups, from being number-driven to becoming value-driven and to acknowledge exemplary student activities around the world. The goal is to improve the quality of activities and to foster knowledge sharing among students.

title: IEEE Regional Exemplary Student Branch Award
description: The purpose of this award is to provide public recognition of exemplary IEEE Student Branch operations. Awards will be presented to those Student Branches that are found to be operated in a manner consistent with the goals of IEEE.

title: IEEE Outstanding Branch Counselor and Branch Chapter Advisor Award
description: Aware of the unusual and dedicated efforts of Student Branch Counselors and Branch Chapter Advisors, the Regional and Technical Activities Boards sponsor a cash award to each of the approximately 20 outstanding Counselors and Advisors around the world.

title: IEEEXtreme – 24-Hour Programming Competition
description: IEEEXtreme is a global challenge in which teams of IEEE Student members – advised and proctored by an IEEE member, and often supported by an IEEE Student Branch – compete in a 24-hour time span against each other to solve a set of programming problems.

title: IEEE Keyboard Typing Marathon (KTM)
description: IEEE KTM is a global, 24-hour online competition that challenges IEEE Student and Professional Members to showcase their typing speed and accuracy, with a practice platform available at all times.

title: SPAx: Student Professional Awareness Program
description: Provides funding for IEEE SBs to plan their own professional development events which include workshops, conferences, and other non-technical ventures, that promote: Student professionalism and professional awareness, Membership recruitment and retention, Transition from IEEE Students to IEEE Young Professionals. SPAx is supported in part by the IEEE Foundation!

title: IEEE Hive
description: IEEE Hive is a gamified innovation and professional development experience co-located with IEEE technical conferences & transforms them into experiential skill-building platforms.

title: IEEE Elevate
description: IEEE Elevate is a global initiative that bridges the gap between academic learning and industry application by enabling students to develop technical skills through hands-on project engagements in collaboration with industry and academia partners.

title: MGA Exemplary Section Student Representative Award
description: The MGA Exemplary Section Student Representative Award recognizes the outstanding leadership of an IEEE student representative within a Section supporting Student Branches, fostering student activities, and encouraging active participation in both Section and Regional events. This prestigious award will be presented annually.

title: Volunteer Leadership Training (VoLT) Program
description: The VoLT Program prepares IEEE volunteers for leadership roles in their local units and beyond. Our graduates are taking positions of leadership across all levels of the organization.
